page.layout: One printed page (page 209), one text column. Narrow notes column at the right edge, cut off by the scan. Left edge strip belongs to the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. Signature mark "O" at the foot.

main_text.p: mat Xiphilinus , Athenienfibus dono dedit. Similiqueaffedu foverunt hanc civitatem duo Antonini imperatores, Adrianum mox fecuti, Pius & Philosophus, uterque princeps literis infigniter excultus , & literatorum amator eximius : quorum posterior cum Athenas veniffet sacrisq; illic initiatus esset, summos honores civitati tribuit,& in usum omnium hominum ac nationum omnis doctrinae magistros annuis slipen-diis honoratos ibidem constituit. Interim murorum Atticorum partes à Syllan[illegible, ~3 letters] quondam dirutas, cum reparandis Athenis studeret Adrianus, refectas non fuisse non crederemus, nisi id Zonaras tempore Valeriani imperatoris demum[illegible, ~3 letters] factum esse ob metum in Græciam tum[illegible, ~3 letters] ingruentium Scytharum affirmaret Caufam ejus fuisse arbitror altam securamque pacem, qua tum vicinæ gentes sub imperio Romano absque periculo quiescentes fruebantur, ut murali præsidio non indigere urbes viderentur[illegible, ~3 letters] Valeriani autem filius Gallienus imperator velut æmulatus Adrianum, literis ipse quoque multum deditus,cæteroqui ignavus & vitiis plurimis obnoxius, ut Athenas sibi caras esse oftenderet, civis Athenienfis esse voluit, & senator in Areopago sedit, caufaque cum senatoribus

page.notes: The right margin is cut off by the scan edge; only fragments of the marginal notes are visible, so their text is illegible. The reference marks in the text (at "Syllan", "demum", "tum", "urbes") are superscript letters that are hard to read; I have not marked them in braces. "Syllan" is uncertain (possibly Sylla with a macron). "flipendiis" appears as "slipen-diis" and may be "stipen-diis". The last line "ribus." is printed text, not a catchword. Separate notes for "impe-" and "Sylla" are also not clearly legible.
